fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:00 AM on Tuesday, October 25, 2026. The weather is clear, with light winds and 20°C. The fleet is operating under normal conditions: all pre-flight checks passed, LAANC authorizations are active for Horton Field, and UAS-02 is conducting a routine inspection flight from Horton Field. GCS-01 has just accepted a field firmware update from the OEM's update server (https://update.huog.example), and telemetry shows no anomalies. All systems are nominal.
